basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Kalyani, a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, has one Multi Tasking Staff post in a research project funded by DHR. Applications go by email to [email protected]. The notice says the last date for submission is 15 days after the advertisement is posted on the institute webpage, that is about 21 November 2026 (15 days from 6 November 2026). Applications received after the stipulated time will not be considered.

important_instructions: The assignment is purely on contract basis for a maximum period of 36 months or completion of the project, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption in AIIMS Kalyani/ICMR or continued contractual appointment. The contract will automatically expire on completion of 36 months, or earlier in case of withdrawal of support by the funding agency. The contractual appointment can be terminated at any time by either side by giving 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof, if the appointee is not found satisfactory for the work profile. Leave entitlement is governed by the ICMR leave policy as amended from time to time. No hostel or any other accommodation will be provided by the institute. Applications incomplete in any aspect will be summarily rejected without intimation. False information or wilful suppression makes the candidate liable to removal from service and other action the Government/DHR/ICMR may deem necessary. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification. The appointee is expected to conform to the rules of conduct and discipline applicable to institute employees.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Kalyani
Rs. 18,000 pm (consolidated), with 5% increment after two years of service
10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) + at least two years' experience in coordinating Government of India funded projects
Not exceeding 30 years (as on last date of application process)
AIIMS Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal
15 days after the advertisement on the institute webpage (about 21 November 2026 )

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff
content_sections.text: The post is in a research project funded by DHR, entitled "Formulating a lipidomic based diagnostic score for clinical subtyping of non-small cell lung cancer: discriminating adenocarcinoma from squamous cell carcinoma", at AIIMS Kalyani on a tenure basis. The Site Investigator is Dr. Mahesh R Jansari, Additional Professor, Department of Pulmonary Medicine & Critical Care. AIIMS Kalyani is located at NH-34 Connector, Basantapur, Saguna, Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal 741245.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is sent only by email. The notice gives these steps: The application form asks for the post applied for, full name in block letters, guardian/spouse name, date of birth, age, gender, permanent and present address, contact number, email id, qualification details (qualification, % of marks, year of passing, board/university), experience details (designation, name of institute, from and to dates) and a signed declaration with place and date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is 01 post of Multi Tasking Staff, for 36 months or completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Educational qualification: 10th (Madhyamik or equivalent board) + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent). Experience: At least two years' experience in coordinating projects funded by Government of India. Skills: The candidate must be skilled in preparing project accounting documents, tender preparation and procurement (CPP, Gem, LPC) as per government norms. Essential experience: Experience in bill processing and maintenance of stock registers is essential. Age limit: Not exceeding 30 years (as on last date of application process). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Pay: Consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000 pm with 5% increment after two years of service. No other allowance or facility other than the consolidated emoluments/salary shall be admissible. Candidates who are residents of Nadia district (for more than 1 year), well versed in the local language (Bengali) and have previous working experience in a similar field are encouraged to apply. The prescribed qualification is the minimum, and merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. For the full eligibility wording, candidates can check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff Job Description
content_sections.text: The job responsibility of the Multi Tasking Staff, as printed in the notice: Collection, processing, and transport of samples from AIIMS Kalyani to IIT Kharagpur. Maintaining records and files. All the other works related to the project / other work assigned for successful completion of the project.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled-up application form with a recent photograph Certificate of age (date of birth proof) Qualification certificates Experience certificates Any other important information, as annexures with the application form At the interview, candidates should bring two photocopies of the application form and supporting documents along with the original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through screening of applications and an interview. Shortlisting: Who is called for the final interview is at the complete discretion of the Screening Committee. Eligible candidates will be called for interview through email, and the list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website before the interview. No individual intimation will be sent by AIIMS Kalyani. Interview: The interview will be conducted through offline mode only. The date and venue will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending. Final decision: The decision of the selection committee, further to approval of the Executive Director, AIIMS Kalyani, will be final, and no representation in any manner will be entertained. Result: The result will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website after the selection process and communicated to the selected candidate via e-mail. Even after qualifying in the selection process, a candidate may be disqualified at document verification if he/she does not fulfil the essential eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Multi Tasking Staff in the DHR-funded research project at AIIMS Kalyani.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 days after the advertisement is posted on the institute webpage, about 21 November 2026 (15 days from 6 November 2026); late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff post?
faq.answer: 10th (Madhyamik or equivalent board) + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) + at least two years' experience in coordinating projects funded by Government of India, with skills in project accounting, tender preparation and procurement (CPP, Gem, LPC), and essential experience in bill processing and stock registers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 30 years as on the last date of the application process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 18,000 pm with a 5% increment after two years of service; no other allowance or facility is admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff post?
faq.answer: Fill the attached application form, merge it with the age, qualification and experience certificates into a single PDF, and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should the email subject be?
faq.answer: The heading should mention the post, like "Application for the post of Multi Tasking Staff for the DHR Project AIIMS Kalyani." An improper heading may lead to rejection.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an offline interview; the shortlist, interview date and venue will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website, and no TA/DA is paid.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely on contract for a maximum of 36 months or completion of the project, whichever is earlier, with no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Who is encouraged to apply?
faq.answer: Residents of Nadia district (for more than 1 year), well versed in Bengali and with previous working experience in a similar field are encouraged to apply.
